goal: Extract tilth's parsing substrate into a tilth-core library crate that the tilth binary consumes, with tilth's CI trio still green, as the proposal branch weed builds on.

work.prompt:
You are refactoring the tilth repository (a Rust MCP server and CLI for AST-aware code intelligence, ~470 unit tests, clippy pedantic). You are at the repository root of an isolated git worktree on the `tilth-core` branch, which is tilth's `main` at v0.9.0. Work here directly; leave changes in the working tree; do not create branches, commit, or push.

## The task

Extract the parsing substrate into a library crate `tilth-core` so that another crate (weed, a static diff judge) can depend on it without depending on tilth's MCP server, formatters or CLI. Turn the repository into a Cargo workspace whose ROOT package stays `tilth` (the binary, `src/main.rs`), so `fuzz/Cargo.toml` (`path = ".."`), `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `install.sh` and `cargo install --path .` keep working unchanged. Add `crates/tilth-core` as a workspace member and make `tilth` depend on it by path: `tilth-core = { path = "crates/tilth-core", version = "0.9.0" }`. Give the crate real metadata: name `tilth-core`, version `0.9.0`, edition 2021, license MIT, description "tilth's parsing substrate: tree-sitter outlines, language detection, test-file classification, imports and callers", repository `https://github.com/jahala/tilth`. Move the tree-sitter grammar dependencies with it; tilth keeps only what it still uses directly.

## What the crate must expose (this is the acceptance surface)

A consumer with only `tilth-core` must be able to:
1. detect a path's file type and language: `detect_file_type(&Path) -> FileType`, with `FileType` and `Lang` public (today `src/lang/mod.rs`, `src/types.rs`)
2. get outline entries for content in a language: `get_outline_entries(&str, Lang) -> Vec<OutlineEntry>` with `OutlineEntry` and `OutlineKind` public, including children and line ranges (today `src/lang/outline.rs`, `src/types.rs`)
3. classify a path as a test file: `is_test_file(&Path) -> bool` — today `pub(crate)` in `src/types.rs`; make it `pub`
4. get the test structure (suites and cases with lines) of a test file's content: today `src/read/outline/test_file.rs::outline` returns a formatted string; keep that, and ADD a structured form that returns entries (name, kind suite|case, start line, end line, depth) so a consumer does not parse text
5. import handling: `is_import_line`, `is_external`, `extract_import_source`, `resolve_related_files_with_content` (today `src/read/imports.rs`, `src/lang/outline.rs`) — make them `pub`
6. callers of a symbol across a scope: `find_callers_batch` and `CallerMatch` (today `src/search/callers.rs`) — make `pub`; and file-level dependency analysis `analyze_deps` with `DepsResult`, `LocalDep`, `Dependent` (today `src/search/deps.rs`)

Decide the module set yourself from the real dependency graph: move what these need (at minimum `src/lang/*`, `src/types.rs`, `src/read/outline/*`, `src/read/imports.rs`, `src/search/callers.rs`, `src/search/callees.rs`, `src/search/callee_query.rs`, `src/search/deps.rs`, and the parts of `src/error.rs`, `src/index/*`, `src/cache.rs` they require). Leave in tilth: `src/mcp/*`, `src/main.rs`, `src/install.rs`, `src/map.rs`, `src/overview.rs`, `src/diff/*`, `src/edit*.rs`, `src/session.rs`, `src/timeout.rs`, `src/budget.rs`, `src/format.rs`, and the search orchestration/formatting in `src/search/mod.rs` unless a moved module needs a helper from it (then move the helper, not the orchestration). Where a moved module needs something that stays (e.g. a formatter), split the data function from the formatting function rather than moving presentation into the core crate. MOVE files with `git mv`; never copy — a file that exists in both crates is a failure. Update every `crate::` path in tilth to `tilth_core::` and adjust visibility (`pub(crate)` → `pub`) only where a consumer needs it; keep pedantic clippy clean in both crates (add per-item `#[allow]` only with a one-line reason, as the codebase already does).

Keep every existing unit test: tests move with their modules and still run under `cargo test --workspace`. Keep `src/lib.rs`'s `__fuzz` module working for the fuzz targets. Write a NEW integration test `crates/tilth-core/tests/api.rs` FIRST (it must fail to compile before the crate exists) that exercises each of the six surfaces above on small inline samples in TypeScript, Python, Rust and Go, and asserts concrete results (a known function name in the outline, a known test case in the test structure, a known import source, a known caller line).

One pre-existing lint: `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` on this toolchain (rustc 1.98) fails on `src/overview.rs:693` (`manual_is_variant_and`); apply the suggested `is_ok_and` rewrite so the CI trio can be green.

Write `docs/tilth-core-extraction.md`: what moved and why, the public surface with one line per item, what stayed and why, how a consumer depends on it (path today, git dependency on this branch until published, crates.io later), and the version policy (lockstep with tilth). Update the project-structure block in `CLAUDE.md` to the new layout so it stays true.

## Definition of done — run this yourself before finishing; it is the gate the conductor runs

    bash -lc 'cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && test -f crates/tilth-core/Cargo.toml && cargo test -p tilth-core --test api && ! diff -rqs src crates/tilth-core/src 2>/dev/null | grep -q identical'

If it does not exit 0, you are not done.

## Rules

- Delete with `trash`, never `rm`. Never `git reset`. Never touch the git stash. Do not commit, branch, push, or publish.
- No stubs, TODOs, placeholders, or commented-out code. No copied code between the crates. Match the style of the surrounding code (pedantic clippy, doc comments on public items).
- Do not change behaviour: no test may be weakened, skipped, or deleted; tilth's output must be byte-identical (the byte-lock tests in `src/mcp/mod.rs` pin the instructions and must still pass unchanged).
- Scratch files go in `.loop-scratch/` only.
- In your FINAL message, list every file you moved or deleted, with the word "moved" or "deleted" beside each, and name `src/lib.rs` explicitly if it lost most of its lines. Then give the public surface of `tilth-core` as it stands, and the exact output line of `cargo test --workspace`.
- If you are genuinely blocked, write BLOCKED.md at the repo root: what you tried, what stopped you, what a fix needs. An honest BLOCKED.md beats a faked green.
